title: Easy to use!
body: Such a helpful app - simple but very effective
author: Mariejvv

title: Great App but super high non-region specific pricing
body: The App is really smooth and well built, and compliments the book so well - it’s just got such a hefty price tag (that doesn’t seem region specific) that I’ll probably never end up using it and just try a free alternative. This comes after already paying for the book (which is really worth it btw!). I wished there was some price adjustment if you bought the book, like scan the barcode and get a special price - I’d probably feel a lot more inclined then. But to all those that do use, best of luck on your habit journey!
author: Jhkobs

title: Makes It Easy
body: Love this app already. I already read the book and enjoyed it so I knew this app was gonna play a huge part in my healthy habits. Thank you James Clear, you’re a genius!
author: Fín Art

title: Talk about price gauging
body:
The app looks amazing that’s for sure, clean, good UX, but whatever the person who set the price was smoking, needs to start shipping that with the app.

A steep price for tracking a max of 3 habits, and let’s be honest there are dozens of apps that can do the same including the reminders app that ships with the phone, even a well placed post-it bot can do the same thing and I’d use thousands of those before I’ve even covered 1 months cost.
author: RemeJuan

title: Great app with a hefty price tag
body:
The atoms app is a sure winner in the habits tracking/building apps but the price tag gave me a bit of a fright and it made me reconsider doing the trial because living in South Africa the monthly price is not an easy amount for most to pay over. This is almost double a Netflix subscription. 

I was very excited to try this out when I got the mail from James, but I guess this is aimed at a very specific market, and unfortunately I am not part of that market… yet! :) 

Just leaving an honest review for others and hopefully James Clear and Co. to consider as well.
author: Chris2Brooks

title: Great app but way to expensive
body: Love the app but it's just too pricey.
author: DeanoGenelli

title: Subscription cost too high for South Africa
body: I love Atomic Habits. I read the book when it first came out and have advocated it to many others. Was super excited to see the app but the subscription cost is too high especially as it seems it does not support family share. Would consider it if this was an option and I could share with my 14 year old.
author: Silver Design

title: Not worth it
body: I paid for your book. Now you expect users to pay $220 a year to track 3 habits with pro. There are a thousand habit trackers out there,many of which are free. I understand that developing an app comes with costs and you want to make a profit, but do you really need a profit with something as simple as a habit tracking app by price gouging your readers when you can already buy anything you want, when you’re known world wide. It just comes off as greedy. It could’ve been free and attracted more people to buy your books. I would rather write them down on a piece of paper.
author: JohnSchneider629

title: Delighted there's an app
body: Am a HUGE Atomic Habits fan, having used it to make a lot of positive changes in my life, but have long been frustrated by the lack of a digital mechanism to record my progress. Imagine my delight there is now an app, built with the author himself. Tested it in beta and I love the clean design and simplicity and the gamification that rewards you with ability to record more habits by recording habits. Well done James.
author: DJ JustSpin

title: I really want to give this 5 stars...
body: It's beautiful, functional, practical... I really love the book and the newsletters but the cost of the subscription is a pill I can't justify following. I guess I will stick with my free trial for now.
author: Blugh-0091
